news.headline: Cognex Launches New Wafer Reader to Help Semiconductor Manufacturers Scale Production
news.summary: Cognex Corporation (NASDAQ: CGNX), the global technology leader in industrial machine vision, today announced the launch of the In-Sight® 1750 Series, a next-generation wafer and panel identification system designed to help semiconductor manufacturers reduce disruptions, improve traceability, and maintain throughput.

news.headline: Baird Maintains Neutral on Cognex, Lowers Price Target to $70
news.summary: Baird  analyst Richard Eastman   maintains Cognex (NASDAQ:CGNX) with a Neutral and lowers the price target from $78 to $70.
